title: STD-2: Cloudflare McpAgent / Durable Object adapter and AI Gateway
body:
**Owner:** **staff**
**Trigger:** none
**Done check:** register entry `cloudflare-agents` moves from planned to supported with a passing test
**Status:** closed

Add an adapter behind the existing ports; route BS-4 executor model calls through AI Gateway.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 248.3 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
